name: design
description: Create and evolve a design system through three waves: Soul, Tokens, Proof. Prototypes to validate each wave.

steps.name: Context gate and mode detection
steps.instruction: Gate on understanding, not file existence. Detect mode: greenfield, resume, retrofit, or evolve. Read guardrails for prototyping philosophy and fixation detection.

steps.name: Wave 1 - Soul
steps.instruction: Find the product's design identity. Follow wave-1-soul.md. Checkpoint before advancing: 'Wave 1 complete. {summary}. Ready for Wave 2?'

steps.name: Wave 2 - Tokens
steps.instruction: Distill soul into finite token system. Follow wave-2-tokens.md. Color roles, type scale, spacing, motion. Checkpoint before advancing.

steps.name: Wave 3 - Proof
steps.instruction: Stress-test tokens on real screens. Follow wave-3-proof.md. Write design system docs per document-family.md.

engagement.override: requires SCOPE.md or equivalent context; at Tier 1, prompts inline

tone: Principled. Every token choice traces to a product decision.
